title: Delivery Workflow Configuration
description: Optional workflow configuration. Lives at .workflow/config.json. All fields are optional; the workflow uses sensible defaults without this file.

project_type_hint.description: Pre-set if project type is known before intake. Skips type detection during init.

skip_states.description: States to skip for experienced users who want a faster path. Only discover and frame are skippable. Skipped states log a transition event with forced: true.

guard_overrides.description: Per-guard strictness overrides. Keys are guard names (e.g., 'brief_populated', 'acceptance_criteria_testable'). Values control enforcement level.

artifact_paths.description: Custom paths for generated artifacts. Defaults are the project root.

capabilities.description: Harness capabilities detected or declared at init time. Used to branch behavior in SKILL.md.
